About Pipeline Fixtures

This fixture site is used for owned-fixture pipeline acceptance testing. It provides a controlled, self-contained multi-page scenario.

Validation Coverage

  • Multi-page link discovery (home → catalog → about)
  • Query-string preserved page identity (catalog?sale=1)
  • Body-mounted Portal state capture (country selector)
  • Secondary interactive expand (language panel)
  • Lazy-loaded images, inline SVG, CSS backgrounds, web font
  • Dual viewport: 1440×1000 (desktop) and 390×844 (mobile)
  • Interrupt-and-resume pipeline verification
  • Admission gate negative cases
